description: Servizio WMS Rete Geodetica is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by antincendio.regione.abruzzo.it. The service dynamically produces the map of the Regional Geotopographic Network consisting of summits of a network of planoaltimetric trust points. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Geodetic Network Service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include servizio, wms, consultazione, infoMapAccessService, rete geodetica. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
